title: Red Maple
body:
A chopped up tree. Can be turned into smooth planks with a handsaw or a sander! It can also be put into a schematic.

Introduction

The Red Maple tree is a tree found in Finlay Island at the Grasslands and Farlands. Other trees that can be found with this tree include Spruce, Birch, and Oak. Its characteristics include a red-purple bark, red leaves, and a pale beige inside. The Red Maple tree cannot spawn fruit.

The raw form of this tree will sell for $1.2 per stud. Once sanded, it sells for $13.22 per stud. If it is planked it will sell for $16.53. Due to the market updates, these values may change day-to-day. Make sure to check the market at the Resource Hub in game for current pricing.

Like all trees, ores, and rocks, the Red Maple tree can be used for filling schematics and blueprints.

Obtaining

Red maple can be cut or mined using a rusty axe or any higher-quality tool. It requires 4 swings with a rusty axe, 2 swings with a steel axe, 2 swings with a refined axe, and only 1 swing with a celestial hammer or a reinforced axe.

For processing, it requires a rusty sander or a steel planker or higher.

Trivia

- This tree can be considered common due to the difficulty level of obtaining.

- The Red Maple tree is one of the base game tree types.

- The Red Maple tree is heavier than the average tree. It may need to be dragged and/or picked up using the Grabby Grabber or the Grabbiest Grabber.

- The Red Maple tree stands roughly 25-31 studs tall, slightly taller than the Oak tree on average.
